NOTE
**Still not ready — commits need cleanup and the checklist isn't the template's**

New: The author added a regression test case (the one they asked about) and, earlier, before/after screenshots. Missing: the four commits aren't organized (separate "Fixes #17419" and lint-fix commits, vague messages, and the test commit cites #17418 instead of #17419), and the self-review checklist is a custom list rather than the PR template's.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave it with laurynmm, who gave the earlier feedback.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the test and screenshots! Please squash the lint fix and the "Fixes" commit into the commits they belong to, so the history follows our [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html) (note the test commit says #17418, not #17419), and use the self-review checklist from the PR template.
```
